verdict.rationale: Cursor exposes a broad and well-documented API/SDK surface — Cloud Agents API (create/manage/stream/cancel agents, artifacts), Admin/Analytics/AI-Code-Tracking APIs, TypeScript/Python SDK, CLI with headless/JSON output, webhooks, and Automations triggered via API/schedule/events — covering most agentic and team-management workflows performable in the UI (cursor-supp-cloud-agents-api, cursor-supp-apis-overview, cursor-supp-sdk, cursor-supp-cli-headless). However, there's no evidence that purely interactive/editor-native UI capabilities (tab completion, inline chat editing, Plan Mode UI, live diff review) have full programmatic parity — the APIs focus on agent orchestration and telemetry, not 1:1 mirroring of every UI interaction. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of API parity for editor-native features like tab completion/inline chat, and independent confirmation that all UI actions map to API calls rather than just agent/automation workflows.
